All degree-seeking students must complete the University’s Liberal Education requirements.
At least 18 upper-division credits in the major must be taken at the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. Verify this requirement with your advisor or APAS.

For more information on how to transfer into CBS please visit our website here:
